AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Model = coalesce(

content.json:
# Azure AI Model Latency — P50 · P90 · P99

Foundry inference latency broken down by deployed model. Source: `ApiManagementGatewayLogs.BackendTime` (wall-clock ms at Foundry, excludes APIM policy overhead and App Gateway).

Model names are extracted from the backend URL:
- **OpenAI-compatible API** (`/openai`): `/openai/deployments/{model}/chat/completions`
- **Native Foundry inference API** (`/models`): `/models/{model}/chat/completions`

| Section | What it answers |
|---|---|
| **Latency over time** | How is each deployed model's tail latency trending? Select a percentile above. |
| **Model Summary** | For the selected time window, what are P50 · P90 · P99 and total request count per model? |

**Diagnostic guide:**
- P99 spike on one model only → model-specific cold start, quota pressure, or degraded deployment
- P99 spike on all models simultaneously → Foundry primary pool saturation or failover event
- Large P50 → P99 spread → bimodal traffic mix (semantic cache hits + cold inferences in the same bucket)

To see which region each model is being routed to, cross-reference with the **Backend Routing Report** workbook.

## Latency over Time — P{Percentile} per Deployed Model

One line per deployed model. Use the **Percentile** selector above to switch between P50 (typical), P90 (elevated), and P99 (tail / worst-case). Source: `ApiManagementGatewayLogs.BackendTime`.

content.query:
let model_filter = dynamic([{ModelFilter}]);
let apimReqs = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Model = coalesce(
    tostring(Properties["Response-Header-X-Model-Name"]),
    extract(@"/deployments/([^/?]+)", 1, Url),
    "")
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where array_length(model_filter) == 0 or tostring(model_filter[0]) == "value:all" or Model in~ (model_filter)
| project OperationId, Model, TimeGenerated;
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| join kind=inner apimReqs on OperationId
| summarize ['Latency (ms)'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, {Percentile}), 1)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity}), Model
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Foundry inference P{Percentile} latency over time — one line per deployed model

content.json:
## Model Latency Summary

Aggregate percentiles for the full selected time range. All values are Foundry inference time only (ms) — APIM and App Gateway overhead are excluded. Sorted by model name; click any column header to re-sort.

content.query:
let model_filter = dynamic([{ModelFilter}]);
let apimReqs = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Model = coalesce(
    tostring(Properties["Response-Header-X-Model-Name"]),
    extract(@"/deployments/([^/?]+)", 1, Url),
    "")
| where isnotempty(Model)
| where array_length(model_filter) == 0 or tostring(model_filter[0]) == "value:all" or Model in~ (model_filter)
| project OperationId, Model;
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| join kind=inner apimReqs on OperationId
| summarize
    ['P50 (ms)'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 1),
    ['P90 (ms)'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 90), 1),
    ['P99 (ms)'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 99), 1),
    Requests     = count()
  by Model
| sort by Model asc
content.title: P50 · P90 · P99 and request count per deployed model — full selected time range
